summary: An independent yes/no. Several of them are several separate questions.

pairs.dont: Use checkboxes for a choice where only one answer is allowed.
pairs.do: Use Radio for one-of-many, Checkbox for any-of-many.
pairs.why: A checkbox says each option is an independent question. If ticking one should untick another, the control is lying about the shape of the choice.

pairs.dont: Use a Checkbox for something that takes effect immediately.
pairs.do: Use Switch for an immediate change, Checkbox for something a Save button confirms.
pairs.why: A checkbox reads as a form value — it has been marked, not applied. A switch reads as a live setting. Getting these the wrong way round is how people click Save on a page that already saved.

pairs.dont: Let someone click a parent checkbox into the indeterminate state.
pairs.do: Derive it — indeterminate means some children are ticked, never a third thing to choose.
pairs.why: Indeterminate is a report, not an option. A three-way cycle on click leaves people unable to tell what they just asked for.

pairs.dont: Leave the label unassociated so only the 20px box is clickable.
pairs.do: Wrap it in Field, or pair it with a real label.
pairs.why: A 20px target is below every touch guideline, and the label is the part people aim at. Associating it makes the whole phrase clickable.

pairs.dont: Label it with a negative — "Do not send notifications".
pairs.do: Label the positive and let the tick mean yes — "Send notifications".
pairs.why: A ticked box next to a negative is a double negative, and people have to read it twice to work out what is on.

pairs.dont: Leave a disabled checked box painted like a live one.
pairs.do: Mute it, so disabled reads as disabled whether ticked or not.
pairs.why: A checked box at full strength invites a click that does nothing. This was a real defect in the Figma component, found while building this one.

a11y: Radix renders a real button with role=checkbox and aria-checked, including "mixed" for indeterminate — the tri-state is announced, not just drawn.
Space toggles; the label is a click target once associated through Field.
aria-invalid colours the box and the focus ring together, so the failure does not depend on noticing one thin border.
